breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a preamble with two conflicting definitions for the spatial grid (one for periodic domains, and an override that was incorrect for periodic domains). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory override and used the definition specified in the 'Numerical method requirements' section, which is consistent with the ground truth prompt's resolution of removing the contradictory text.
